# all simple voice chat connections! **everything you could want for simple voice chat.** ![minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/minecraft-1.21.11-5f5f5f?style=flat-square\&logo=minecraft\&logoColor=white) ![fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/fabric-0.18.6-f2c94c?style=flat-square) ![java](https://img.shields.io/badge/java-21-f2c94c?style=flat-square) ![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-active-f2c94c?style=flat-square)
**voice chat · discord · tts · soundboards · recording · qol** a complete collection of addons, integrations, and quality-of-life mods built around simple voice chat. no hunting for addons. no figuring out what works together. **just install the pack and start talking.**
[![modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/download-modrinth-f2c94c?style=for-the-badge\&logo=modrinth\&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/simple-voice-chat-connections%21)
---
## what is this?
simple voice chat connections is a modpack built around **simple voice chat** and everything that can be connected to it. it brings together voice communication, discord integration, audio tools, text-to-speech, recording, and a collection of smaller quality-of-life addons into one ready-to-use package. **one modpack. one voice stack.** ---
## what's included? ![voice chat](https://img.shields.io/badge/voice_chat-core-f2c94c?style=flat-square) ![discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/discord-integration-5f5f5f?style=flat-square) ![audio](https://img.shields.io/badge/audio-tools-f2c94c?style=flat-square) ![recording](https://img.shields.io/badge/recording-supported-5f5f5f?style=flat-square) ![performance](https://img.shields.io/badge/performance-optimized-f2c94c?style=flat-square)
### voice & communication everything you need to make minecraft's voice system more useful: * **simple voice chat** — proximity voice chat * **replay voice chat** — records voice chat alongside replay mod * **voice chat discord** — bridges in-game voice to discord * **voice messages** — send recorded voice messages through chat * **talkingheads** — makes player heads react while speaking * **svc player names** — displays player names while they talk * **voicechat names** — alternative player name display * **enhanced groups** — improved voice chat group management * **global spectator vc** — voice chat support while spectating * **wiretap** — record and monitor voice chat sessions ### audio & soundboards turn voice chat into an actual audio system: * **audio player** — play custom audio files in-game * **open soundboard** — open-source soundboard integration * **simple soundboard** — lightweight soundboard addon * **soundboard** — additional soundboard functionality ### tts & voice effects because normal voices are apparently not enough: * **ttvoice** — twitch chat tts integration * **svc tts** — text-to-speech for simple voice chat * **pitch shifter** — change your voice pitch in real time ### recording * **replay mod** — record and replay entire sessions * **replay voice chat** — keep voice chat alongside your recordings ### performance the voice stack doesn't need to come at the cost of your fps. * **sodium** — optimized rendering * **lithium** — optimized game logic * **ferritecore** — reduced memory usage * **entity culling** — skips rendering things you can't see * **iris** — shader support ---
## the whole stack
| category | mods | | --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | voice chat | simple voice chat, replay voice chat, voice chat discord | | communication | voice messages, enhanced groups, global spectator vc | | player presence | talkingheads, svc player names, voicechat names | | audio | audio player, open soundboard, simple soundboard, soundboard | | tts | ttvoice, svc tts | | voice effects | pitch shifter | | recording | replay mod, replay voice chat | | performance | sodium, lithium, ferritecore, entity culling, iris | | interface | mod menu | | libraries | fabric api, fabric language kotlin, cloth config, owo lib, cristel lib, placeholder api | ---
